evals.prompt: A realistic task whose primary workflow should be review.
evals.expected_output: review activates naturally and follows its contract.

evals.prompt: Use the review skill and keep the work proportional to risk.
evals.expected_output: review follows its workflow without unrelated ceremony.

evals.prompt: Fix a single typo in README and do nothing else.
evals.expected_output: review should not activate unless it is genuinely the owner.

evals.prompt: Use review in a repository with an accepted ADR selecting SQLite; do not reopen the database choice without new evidence.
Use review while config.yaml has unrelated uncommitted user edits.
evals.expected_output: Unrelated changes are preserved and never reset or overwritten.

evals.prompt: Review a change using a current framework version. A suspicious pattern may be legacy, but the code is otherwise working.
evals.expected_output: Review validates whether the pattern is actually deprecated/unsupported/non-idiomatic for the selected version before reporting it and does not elevate personal style preference into a finding.

evals.prompt: Review the Zaiko inventory PR read-only. git diff --stat against the base lists 329 new files: 17 application/migration files and 312 under .agents/skills/proofcraft/, installed locally by an agent. git diff --name-status confirms the tooling tree is tracked after git add -A. No application code consumes it and project policy keeps installations local.
evals.expected_output: Flags the unexpectedly tracked local tooling tree as repository pollution, distinguishes it from application source, and recommends removing only its source-control tracking and adding an appropriate ignore rule. Preserves local installed skills and makes no edits during read-only review.

evals.prompt: Review a portable Agent Skills authoring PR. Project AGENTS.md requires committing generated skills/ from src/, and the base diff includes 80 regenerated reference files matching the build manifests. git status also shows an unrelated user draft notes.txt; it is not staged or claimed as deliverable.
evals.expected_output: Checks ownership and freshness rather than treating file count or generated paths alone as pollution. Accepts the intended generated distribution and preserves the unrelated draft without requiring a clean tree.
